label: family of morphisms with a fixed target in a category
paraphrase: A family of morphisms with common target in a category C consists of an object U, an index set I, and arrows f_i:U_i→U for each i∈I. The index set may be empty.
scope: The arrows have a common codomain, but source objects may differ. Multiplicity and indexing must be retained, not reduced automatically to the support set.
known_context_variants: support set of arrows discarding repeated occurrences, an associated construction rather than the same family

label: site as category with designated covering families
paraphrase: A site in the Stacks convention is a category C with a set Cov(C) of fixed-target morphism families, closed under isomorphism singleton coverings, compositional refinements, and pullback of coverings along arbitrary arrows (the requisite fiber products must exist).
scope: Stacks 7.6 uses an explicit family-based coverage/prefontopology convention, and a set of coverings to avoid large-class issues; it is not literally the same data as a sieve-based Grothendieck topology.
known_context_variants: associated Grothendieck topology expressed by covering sieves, to be sourced separately
